items.title: feat: preserve PostgreSQL stores in backups and updates (#170828)
items.summary: feat: preserve PostgreSQL stores in backups and updates (#170828) Route archive, local, and Git backups plus updater capture/restore through one engine-aware backup owner. Preserve exact PostgreSQL update captures and restore to a fresh owned namespace with the matched anchor; retain SQLite behavior. Add optional openclaw.databaseEngines capability metadata. An absent field means SQLite-only; installations with physical PostgreSQL stores refuse targets without postgres before mutation. updateAdmissionProtocol remains unchanged. Port enablement (P3-6c/d) requires a published release containing this PR. The port command stays disabled. Validation: 155 focused tests and two clean review rounds; exact-head PostgreSQL conformance, dialect ratchet 10 to 10, and published 2026.10.3 driver update passed with readyz 200. Three unrelated CI failures are documented in the PR under the authorized landing exception.

items.title: test(agents): handle expected worker deadline before timer advance
items.summary: test(agents): handle expected worker deadline before timer advance The real worker deadline test attached its rejection handler after awaiting asynchronous timer advancement. The intentional rejection therefore surfaced as unhandled despite passing fallback assertions in scheduled main 38439503520. Attach the handler immediately, before awaiting worker notification or advancing timers. Preserve real IPC, timeout classification and the configured fallback assertions. Culprit: 4ea40f2b890e9359cb15faae433d0807c0d52d5a (#156650). Codex review and changed-file format/lint/diff checks pass.

items.title: test(release): drain checksum input in publisher fixture
items.summary: test(release): drain checksum input in publisher fixture The scheduled main run 38439503520 failed the signed Linux publisher case with status 141. Its sha256sum stub exited without reading the checksum pipe, allowing printf to receive SIGPIPE under pipefail. Drain stdin before successful exit; preserve the real workflow and all four existing branch assertions. Culprit: 86d2daf6c8b8aa0ba19e29594776a44e00e7c48f (#171125). Codex review and changed-file format/lint/diff checks pass.

items.title: fix(synology-chat): stop one account's send burst from delaying other…
items.summary: fix(synology-chat): stop one account's send burst from delaying other accounts (#144991) fix(synology-chat): pace sends per webhook so accounts don't delay each other Synology Chat used one process-wide send queue, so a burst of outbound messages on one account delayed every other account's messages. Sends are now paced per incoming webhook URL, and idle per-webhook slots are pruned once their cooldown has elapsed. Pacing and ordering for the same webhook are unchanged. Proof: built Gateway, /tools/invoke sends to two loopback webhook servers: during an 8-message burst on account A, account B's message took 4,028 ms on main and 97 ms on the candidate. A's messages stayed ordered and paced. Thanks @Abhishek-B-R. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 逾1.6萬個Supabase資料庫暴露於公開網路，恐洩漏敏感資料
items.summary: 資安業者UpGuard於10月1日發布報告，指出該公司掃描約30萬個使用Supabase資料庫的網域後，發現16,326個資料庫存在設定錯誤，資料表可被公開讀取。Supabase是提供託管PostgreSQL資料庫及後端服務的平臺，常用於為網站與行動應用程式提供後端支援，而UpGuard發現的逾1.6萬個暴露Supabase資料庫中，超過一半含有個人識別資訊，部分還包含明文密碼、身分驗證權杖及一次性密碼（OTP），少數資料表則疑似含信用卡資料。
